d: US President Donald Trump made an unusual costume choice at his Mar-a-Lago Halloween party, saying he came dressed as “himself”. But the Halloween festivities also turned to the looming Iran crisis, with Trump saying he is “in no hurry” to decide on fresh strikes. Mediators are working to prevent a new outbreak of war, even as the US president says “one or two sites” in Iran still need “taking care of”. What does Trump's latest message mean for the possibility of renewed military action? Firstpost reports on Halloween at Mar-a-Lago and the latest developments in the US-Iran standoff.
